course_info.trial_description:
The trial lesson is an introductory and informal lesson to get to know each other. 

Together, we will assess your future goals for learning, focus on your needs, and your future plans for learning English.

I can, if this is something you desire, correct your grammar and pronunciation during this lesson. This will enable me to provide you with information on the areas you should focus on in relation to your learning outcomes.

You will have the opportunity to ask questions about future lesson plans etc. It is a friendly, free, and open space.  

If you are wanting to practice for your upcoming IELTS exam, you will be given the opportunity to speak at length during your trial on typical IELTS topics. This will give me an idea of what areas you need most help with. For example, perhaps you need to improve your grammar, grammatical range, or vocabulary.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation Practice and Correction
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you want to improve your conversational practice? Conversations are the key to language development, exchanging ideas and thoughts, and listening. During our 'face to face' conversational practice, we are fully present to one another's thoughts and feelings and body language, and it is here where I will help to improve your confidence in engaging more fully in conversation with others.

My conversational classes are student directed and you will have the choice to come up with your own topics, which we will discuss before our class. You can choose any topic, from your favourite music, favourite food, world news, or places to travel, for example. 

My conversational classes are not about correctness, but I will help improve your pronunciation, grammar, and listening, along the way. 

During our conversational classes, you will learn new vocabulary so that you may participate in specific conversations during your everyday life. For example, you will learn different phrases and words relating to certain topics, such as travel.

During our conversational classes, you will learn or improve on both informal and formal conversational skills. 

Homework can be set, if required.

As an experienced IELTS tutor, I can help you understand the language needed for the writing tasks, develop the skills and techniques you’ll need for the reading and listening papers, and provide you with realistic speaking practice.   
Cambridge Exams 
Would you like to be able to prove you’ve reached B2, C1 or C2?  If so, the Cambridge exams are perfect for you.     
FCE, CAE and CPE are tough exams that test your language abilities in every area.  While it’s possible to prepare by yourself, having someone to support you can be a great help.  I can help you develop the language needed for the writing paper, as well as supporting you as you develop your speaking skills.  I also offer plenty of practice with the listening paper as well as exploring the difficult reading questions found in these exams

General English
Do you want to improve your English for your own enjoyment?  If so, a general English class may be just what you need!   
I have taught general English at all levels and am familiar with the grammar and vocabulary for each stage.  Helping you recognise your strengths and improve your weaknesses is important and I regularly check to make sure you are progressing in the best way for you.  

Young Learners 
Are you keen for your child to start learning English?  Or maybe your child is studying English at school, but you think they would benefit from extra speaking practice?  I can help!  
When working with young children, I use graded readers, songs and pictures to make the lessons fun.  With older kids, the lessons stay interactive, but the focus is on enabling them to talk about topics and issues that are important to them.   Parental involvement is important, so I give detailed feedback on your child’s language after each lesson.  I can also provide homework on request.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation and Correction
pro_course_detail.description:
Practice speaking English with a topic of your choice, reduce your grammar and vocabulary mistakes, improve your pronunciation, and learn new words and expressions!

In this class, we will have a conversation about any topic that you choose. It could be a hobby you enjoy, a recent news story, or even your job!

If you prefer, I can choose a topic for us.
 
As we talk, in the first part of the class I will make notes about your pronunciation, use of vocabulary and grammar, and any examples of 'non-native English'.
 
After this, we will take a look at how we can improve your English conversation skills: What mistakes did you make, and which could cause problems? Which mistakes did you make more than once? What useful words or expressions might be helpful next time you talk about this topic?
 
We will then spend the final part of the class practicing the new and/or corrected words and phrases.

pro_course_detail.title: In the News
pro_course_detail.description:
Discussion and conversation about the latest news headlines in your country and around the world, with correction and vocabulary building.

--

"STUDENT LEARNS ENGLISH BY STUDYING NEWS" - Latest Story

Practise talking about current events around the globe, learn to understand headlines, and improve your ability to discuss new topics.

In this class we will look at three current news stories, and:

1) Try to understand the story from just the headline.
2) Discuss the story, and practice giving your opinion in English.
3) Look at any English mistakes and correct them, then try again.

News stories can be an excellent way to study English; they often include past, present, and future; they deal with a wide range of topics; and they are very common in 'small talk' situations, so you should get some chance to practise talking about news in real life!

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Speaking Practice and Improvement
pro_course_detail.description:
Improve your IELTS Speaking score through practice, correction, and strategy.

-

In this class we will:
1) Practise the IELTS Speaking paper under realistic conditions.
2) Look at and correct any mistakes or problems you have.
3) Learn simple strategies for extending your answers and improving your score.
4) Practice again with what we have learned!


Many students are nervous about the IELTS speaking paper, but they don't have to be; it can seem scary at first but the questions follow similar patterns and there are many useful phrases and expressions we can learn to help.
We can look at techniques for giving better answers in all three parts of the speaking test, including the dreaded part 2 monologue!

pro_course_detail.title: Pronunciation Clinic
pro_course_detail.description:
Let's diagnose your pronunciation problems and find a cure!

--

Are you worried about your pronunciation?
Does your English sound too 'foreign'?

Help is here! In this class we will first have a controlled conversation to identify the areas of your pronunciation that need improvement, look at some exercises to ensure that you are forming the correct sounds, then practice using your 'new' pronunciation to get it perfect!

If you already have specific words and sounds that you want to improve, that is fine, just tell me!
